purpose: Reader-facing purpose and use case for every GitHub Actions workflow. The docs generator renders this with the triggers and jobs it reads from the workflow files; a workflow file without an entry, or an entry without a file, fails the generator tests.

.github/workflows/admin.yml.purpose: Builds and tests the steward cockpit when admin code, the shared code it imports, or the shared test support changes.
.github/workflows/admin.yml.useCase: A change under packages/admin or the shared UI and hooks it depends on.

.github/workflows/agent.yml.purpose: Typechecks and tests the messaging agent and its public HTTP API when agent or shared code changes.
.github/workflows/agent.yml.useCase: Bot, webhook, or public API changes.

.github/workflows/ci-gate.yml.purpose: The one required status. It derives the workflows a pull request's changed files should trigger, waits for each to register and report, and fails as soon as one fails or never shows up, so path-filtered workflows cannot silently weaken branch protection.
.github/workflows/ci-gate.yml.useCase: Every pull request on any base branch. Branch protection points here instead of at the per-package workflows.

.github/workflows/client.yml.purpose: Builds, tests, and runs the client Playwright project for the public site and the installed PWA.
.github/workflows/client.yml.useCase: Client views, routes, service worker, PWA packaging, or the shared UI they render.

.github/workflows/codeql-cache-prune.yml.purpose: Deletes stale CodeQL overlay databases from the Actions cache so they cannot evict the Foundry caches the contracts jobs rely on.
.github/workflows/codeql-cache-prune.yml.useCase: Housekeeping only: it runs after every push to develop and hourly as a backstop. Nothing to trigger by hand unless the cache fills up.

.github/workflows/contracts-manual.yml.purpose: Runs a chosen contracts operation (fork readiness, the CI lane, or both) on demand by calling the Contracts workflow.
.github/workflows/contracts-manual.yml.useCase: An operator wants a contracts check outside a pull request, for example before a release.

.github/workflows/contracts-nightly.yml.purpose: The deep fuzz and invariant lane: pull-request CI runs the capped test profile for speed, and this run restores full depth through the ci profile.
.github/workflows/contracts-nightly.yml.useCase: Nightly at 03:17 UTC, or on demand after a change to invariants or fuzz targets.

.github/workflows/contracts.yml.purpose: Compiles, lints, and tests the Solidity packages and the contract script suite.
.github/workflows/contracts.yml.useCase: Any change under packages/contracts or the contract scripts; the manual workflow calls it with an operation name.

.github/workflows/coverage-nightly.yml.purpose: Enforces the measured coverage floors across the packages. Pull requests run plain package tests for fast feedback; this lane measures.
.github/workflows/coverage-nightly.yml.useCase: Nightly at 08:43 UTC and after every push to main.

.github/workflows/design.yml.purpose: Checks the design system: Storybook, story coverage, and DesignMD token parity, with optional Chromatic publishing.
.github/workflows/design.yml.useCase: Shared components, styles, tokens, any DESIGN.md, or the docs stylesheet. Dispatch it with publish_chromatic to publish Storybook.

.github/workflows/docs.yml.purpose: Tests the docs generators, audits documentation authority, checks that generated projections and ontology pages are current, and builds the docs site.
.github/workflows/docs.yml.useCase: Anything under docs/, the generator scripts, the skills catalog, or a source a projection reads.

.github/workflows/indexer.yml.purpose: Builds and tests the Envio indexer handlers against the contract ABIs and deployment artifacts.
.github/workflows/indexer.yml.useCase: Indexer handlers, schema, or config, or the ABIs and deployments they read.

.github/workflows/ontology.yml.purpose: Validates the ontology sidecar against the code it anchors and keeps its generated reference pages current.
.github/workflows/ontology.yml.useCase: Ontology edits, the data model and entity matrix projections, or a source the sidecar points at.

.github/workflows/release.yml.purpose: Builds and publishes a tagged release.
.github/workflows/release.yml.useCase: A pushed version tag. Maintainers cut releases from main; nothing to run by hand.

.github/workflows/shared.yml.purpose: Typechecks and tests the shared package: hooks, providers, protocol modules, and UI foundations.
.github/workflows/shared.yml.useCase: Any shared source change. It also runs weekly to catch drift that no pull request touched.

.github/workflows/supply-chain-guardrail.purpose: Checks manifests, lockfiles, and the release-age rule so a dependency change cannot land unreviewed.
